review_evidence: README describes a Lean diagramming/data-visualization DSL with mathematical 2D geometry, affine transformations and a free-monad compositional semantics for marks.

Vizagrams/LinearAlgebra.lean explicitly presents Vec2, affine transformations Mat2Vec2, categorical identity/application/composition, rotations, reflections, projections and coordinate conversions as the mathematical foundation for the framework; FreeMonad.lean defines the compositional 𝕋/η/μ/alg_θ machinery.

A complete scan of 28 Lean files found 420 declaration-style items. There are currently no theorem declarations, but the mathematical structures, interfaces and compositional semantics are independently searchable prior art and therefore fail the high bar for hard exclusion.
summary: Reviewed vizagrams and retain its formal geometric/categorical interfaces and diagram-semantics constructions.
